answer: A new seat requires a unique object id and a deposit address derived from the epoch seed plus the applicant's public key. Three already-seated attesters who have not shared a panel in the last four epochs each sign H(seed, pubkey, object id) only after matching that id to one unspent copper-tagged invoice in a public basalt registry. The registry rejects any id, invoice, or change-output already bound to another key. Those attesters then enter a two-epoch grove cooldown, so a farm cannot recycle one clique to underwrite many names.
